test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

After that long afternoon, / when I quietly entered her room / to hand over the packet to her, / she asked me to sit reluctant

options.text: she asked me to sit reluctant
to hand over the packet to her,
when I quietly entered her room

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**sit reluctant**" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The adjective "**reluctant**" should be modified to adverb form "**reluctantly**" to correctly describe the verb "**sit**".
 
• Adverbs typically modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs, which is the case here.
 
• The correct form should be "**she asked me to sit reluctantly**".

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *After that long afternoon, when I quietly entered her room to hand over the packet to her, she asked me to sit reluctantly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "After that long afternoon," - This segment is grammatically correct and sets the scene for the following actions.
 
• Option 3: "to hand over the packet to her," - This segment correctly describes the purpose of entering the room.
 
• Option 4: "when I quietly entered her room," - This segment is grammatically correct and describes the manner in which the action was performed.
